name: Bean Me Up Coffee
notes: Both photos are of the same coffee stand exterior, not a priced menu board. Photo 1 shows a partial handwritten specials chalkboard (Ghirardelli White Mocha, Caramel Marchiato, Lavender Latte, Chai Tea Latte) with no prices, plus generic category signage ('Specialty Coffees: Mocha's, Espresso, Cappuccino, Etc, Etc...' and 'Goodies: Muffins, Bagels and more'). Photo 2 is the same signage from further back with hours. No itemized priced menu is legible, so dishes left empty per the rule.
